Task context: Fantasy-game asset restoration: a faithful high-definition reconstruction of the EXISTING Might and Magic VII outdoor decoration "7rock08" from the supplied original sprite, as a 3D modelling and texturing reference. It is not a new design.
Input 1 native_front_x3.png is the ORIGINAL native MM7 sprite, enlarged nearest neighbour. It sets the design, shape, proportions and palette. Magenta is background, not part of the rock. Input 2 x2_surface_only.png is for surface material only (fine streaked grey stone), NEVER for design.

View: The rock from the front, camera turned about 30 degrees to the rock's right and raised about 25 degrees, so the crown, the hollow and the depth are visible. Near-orthographic.
ONE free-standing natural rock, centred, generous margins, no ground, grass, shadow, scenery or text. Even soft neutral studio light showing the forms, no dramatic light. Credible photographic stone detail, fully reconstructed not enlarged pixel blocks.

Identity: A single solid crag of dark charcoal-grey stone, about 1.25 times as wide as tall. Body: broad, rounded, weathered mound whose lower sides bulge outward and flare onto the ground, base widest. Silhouette sides convex and lumpy.
Crown: from upper part of SAME stone (grown out of mound, NOT separate stones placed on it) rise two thick pointed horn-like crests leaning slightly toward each other. Taller crest just right of centre is highest point; shorter crest at front left reaches about 85% of height.
Hollow: between and in front of crests a deep rounded cupped hollow is scooped into top of mound, dark inside.
Behind crests: top is a lower rounded lobe.
Ridge: sharp curved ridge runs from tall crest down right front of mound.
Surface: dense fine-grained dark grey stone like slate or basalt, fine parallel streaks and striations running diagonally across faces, small pale specks, a few thin cracks. Matte, slightly weather-polished ridges.
Colour: charcoal grey, mid grey on lit upper faces with faint warm olive-grey tint, darker grey sides, near-black hollow and crevices.
Do NOT add moss, grass, lichen, snow, other rocks, pebbles, base or floor. Do NOT make crests separate stones or spikes. Do NOT make tan, brown, blue or light grey. Do NOT make a tall spire or flat slab. Do NOT crop.
Require one rock about 1.25:1 width to height, two crests of one stone and hollow between them, taller on right of front view, wide flared base, dark charcoal grey fine streaks. True alpha transparency, no painted checkerboard.
runs.reason: Superseded by one targeted correction for apparent halo and tight framing.
